_comment: Hand-maintained supplement to the POM-derived licence report.
com.jaredsburrows.license reads each resolved dependency's POM. That is
accurate for the ~160 components that publish proper <licenses> metadata, but
some artifacts (notably @aar ones) publish an incomplete block. This file is
where those are corrected, and where a dual-licensed dependency's licence
:app:generateThirdPartyLicenses merges this into the generated report and
FAILS the build if any component is still left without a licence, so a new
dependency with a bare POM cannot slip into the notices unnoticed.
Keys are 'group:artifact' WITHOUT the version, so a version bump does not

elections.title: Java Native Access (JNA)
text: JNA is dual-licensed. Its POM declares both LGPL-2.1-or-later and Apache-2.0, with the comment: "Java Native Access (JNA) is licensed under the LGPL, version 2.1 or later, or the Apache License, version 2.0. You can freely decide which license you want to apply to the project."

Pingolin elects the Apache License, Version 2.0 for JNA and distributes it under those terms only. The LGPL option is not exercised. JNA is therefore listed under Apache License 2.0 in the inventory below rather than under both licences.

JNA is used solely as the FFI bridge for the UniFFI-generated bindings to the Pingolin mobile SDK. It is consumed unmodified, as a published binary artifact, and is not statically linked into or otherwise combined with Pingolin code.

net.zetetic:sqlcipher-android.reason: The published POM declares a <license> element with a <url> but no <name>, so the POM scan yields a blank licence. Filled in from the project's own LICENSE file, which is a three-clause BSD licence: 'Copyright (c) 2008-2023, ZETETIC LLC' with the redistribution, binary-reproduction and non-endorsement clauses.

notes.net.zetetic:sqlcipher-android: SQLCipher Community Edition. Zetetic's licence overview is at https://www.zetetic.net/sqlcipher/license/ — the URL the POM points at. Consumed unmodified as a published binary artifact.
notes.org.maplibre.gl:android-sdk: The POM records the licence name as the bare string 'BSD' with the URL https://opensource.org/licenses/BSD-2-Clause; it is reported here under the two-clause name the URL identifies.

_comment: Notes attached to native (Rust) components by crate name. These are
tools/generate-native-licenses.py and would overwrite anything written
native_notes.libsqlite3-sys: Built with the `bundled` feature, so this crate compiles the SQLite C amalgamation into libpingolin_mobile.so. The crate's own MIT licence covers the Rust binding; the bundled SQLite source is separately dedicated to the public domain by its authors (https://sqlite.org/copyright.html), which imposes no attribution condition. Note that `bundled` is plain SQLite — NOT `bundled-sqlcipher`; the SQLCipher terms listed elsewhere in these notices apply to the Android net.zetetic:sqlcipher-android artifact, not to this library.
native_notes.ring: Licensed `Apache-2.0 AND ISC` — a conjunction, not a choice: both sets of terms apply.
